<tr class="re">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_EquityAbstract', window );"><strong>Equity [Abstract]</strong></a></td>
<td class="text">&#160;<span></span>
</td>

<tr class="ro">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_StockholdersEquityNoteDisclosureTextBlock', window );">TEMPORARY EQUITY AND STOCKHOLDERS&#8217; EQUITY (DEFICIT)</a></td>
<td class="text"><p id="xdx_80A_eus-gaap--StockholdersEquityNoteDisclosureTextBlock_z7geqYafnxe1" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><b>NOTE 7: <span id="xdx_827_z7Uz1je9u2d1">TEMPORARY EQUITY AND STOCKHOLDERS&#8217; EQUITY (DEFICIT)</span></b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="text-decoration: underline">Capital Stock</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Company&#8217;s amended Articles of Incorporation
authorized <span id="xdx_90A_eus-gaap--CommonStockSharesAuthorized_c20260630__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--ClassAVotingCommonStockMember_pd" title="Common stock, shares authorized"><span id="xdx_906_eus-gaap--CommonStockSharesAuthorized_iI_c20251231__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--ClassAVotingCommonStockMember_zArBcKEnOvV7" title="Common stock, shares authorized">19,824,168</span></span> shares of Class A Voting Common Stock ($<span id="xdx_902_eus-gaap--CommonStockParOrStatedValuePerShare_c20260630__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--ClassAVotingCommonStockMember_pd" title="Common stock, par value"><span id="xdx_90A_eus-gaap--CommonStockParOrStatedValuePerShare_iI_c20251231__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--ClassAVotingCommonStockMember_zFqmKbVv8MS5" title="Common stock, par value">0.0001</span></span> par), <span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--CommonStockSharesAuthorized_c20260630__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--ClassBVotingCommonStockMember_pd" title="Common stock, shares authorized"><span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--CommonStockSharesAuthorized_iI_c20251231__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--ClassBVotingCommonStockMember_zgGI9OWWuMo2" title="Common stock, shares authorized">175,832</span></span> shares of Class B Non-Voting Common Stock ($<span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--CommonStockParOrStatedValuePerShare_c20260630__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--ClassBVotingCommonStockMember_pd" title="Common stock, par value"><span id="xdx_904_eus-gaap--CommonStockParOrStatedValuePerShare_iI_c20251231__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--ClassBVotingCommonStockMember_zdSejwIMuYig" title="Common stock, par value">0.0001</span></span>
par), <span id="xdx_90D_eus-gaap--PreferredStockSharesAuthorized_c20260630__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__us-gaap--SeriesAPreferredStockMember_pd" title="Preferred stock, shares authorized"><span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--PreferredStockSharesAuthorized_iI_c20251231__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__us-gaap--SeriesAPreferredStockMember_z3n7Te0zV006" title="Preferred stock, shares authorized">3,681,234</span></span> shares of Series A Preferred Stock ($<span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--PreferredStockParOrStatedValuePerShare_c20260630__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__us-gaap--SeriesAPreferredStockMember_pd" title="Preferred stock, par value"><span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--PreferredStockParOrStatedValuePerShare_c20251231__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__us-gaap--SeriesAPreferredStockMember_pd" title="Preferred stock, par value">0.0001</span></span> par), and <span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--PreferredStockSharesAuthorized_iI_c20260630__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--SeniorPreferredStockMember_z6irhgj4HuCk" title="Preferred stock, shares authorized"><span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--PreferredStockSharesAuthorized_iI_c20251231__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--SeniorPreferredStockMember_zT8UM2OvZrP" title="Preferred stock, shares authorized">500,000</span></span> shares of Senior Preferred Stock ($<span id="xdx_902_eus-gaap--PreferredStockParOrStatedValuePerShare_iI_c20260630__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--SeniorPreferredStockMember_zX7I6AnHb8Zi" title="Preferred stock, par value"><span id="xdx_902_eus-gaap--PreferredStockParOrStatedValuePerShare_iI_c20251231__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--SeniorPreferredStockMember_zhKuznkiB4p4" title="Preferred stock, par value">0.0001</span></span> par).</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">As of June 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025,
the Company had <span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--CommonStockSharesIssued_iI_c20260630__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--ClassAVotingCommonStockMember_zLeEwO2ezz0g" title="Common stock, shares issued"><span id="xdx_902_eus-gaap--CommonStockSharesOutstanding_c20260630__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--ClassAVotingCommonStockMember_pd" title="Common stock, shares outstanding"><span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--CommonStockSharesIssued_c20251231__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--ClassAVotingCommonStockMember_pd" title="Common stock, shares issued"><span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--CommonStockSharesOutstanding_iI_c20251231__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--ClassAVotingCommonStockMember_zpfcQK8BXEEa" title="Common stock, shares outstanding">5,289,980</span></span></span></span>
shares of Class A Voting Common Stock issued and outstanding. As of June 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025, the Company had <span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--CommonStockSharesIssued_iI_c20260630__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--ClassBVotingCommonStockMember_zi6yXjM9DxQf" title="Common stock, shares issued"><span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--CommonStockSharesOutstanding_iI_c20260630__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--ClassBVotingCommonStockMember_zGlZOcYUNtQc" title="Common stock, shares outstanding"><span id="xdx_902_eus-gaap--CommonStockSharesIssued_iI_c20251231__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--ClassBVotingCommonStockMember_zDEWje8jlosb" title="Common stock, shares issued"><span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--CommonStockSharesOutstanding_iI_c20251231__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--ClassBVotingCommonStockMember_zPi1hDM24ivh" title="Common stock, shares outstanding">175,707</span></span></span></span>
shares of Class B Non-Voting Common Stock issued and outstanding. The Company had <span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--PreferredStockSharesIssued_iI_c20260630__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__us-gaap--SeriesAPreferredStockMember_zYMVuGu3oZ0e" title="Preferred stock, shares issued"><span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--PreferredStockSharesOutstanding_iI_c20260630__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__us-gaap--SeriesAPreferredStockMember_z1PBKZVBRApc" title="Preferred stock, shares outstanding"><span id="xdx_90D_eus-gaap--PreferredStockSharesIssued_iI_c20251231__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__us-gaap--SeriesAPreferredStockMember_zMjTjvBJH3p1" title="Preferred stock, shares issued"><span id="xdx_90D_eus-gaap--PreferredStockSharesOutstanding_iI_c20251231__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__us-gaap--SeriesAPreferredStockMember_zjrIsFERcC04" title="Preferred stock, shares outstanding">3,681,234</span></span></span></span>
shares of Series A Preferred Stock issued and outstanding as of June 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025. Additionally, the Company has
reserved <span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--CommonStockCapitalSharesReservedForFutureIssuance_iI_c20260630__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--ClassAVotingCommonStockMember__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--N2016EmployeeStockIncentivePlanMember_zdAAurfFfoKa" title="Shares reserved for future issuance">733,424</span>
shares of Class A Voting Common Stock ($<span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--CommonStockParOrStatedValuePerShare_iI_c20251231__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--ClassAVotingCommonStockMember__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--N2016EmployeeStockIncentivePlanMember_zO2050qOMVSj" title="Common stock, par value">0.0001</span>
par) for issuance under the 2016 Employee Stock Incentive Plan, of which <span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfSharesAvailableForGrant_iI_c20260630__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--ClassAVotingCommonStockMember__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--N2016EmployeeStockIncentivePlanMember_zptdKZx7aiK3" title="Shares available for grant">135,924 </span>remain
available for issuance as of June 30, 2026. <span id="xdx_902_eus-gaap--PreferredStockSharesIssued_iI_c20260630__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--SeniorPreferredStockMember_zXbWTh8S57pa" title="Preferred stock, shares issued"><span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--PreferredStockSharesOutstanding_iI_c20260630__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--SeniorPreferredStockMember_z9MGzxqyxaC4" title="Preferred stock, shares outstanding">500,000</span></span>
shares of Senior Preferred Stock were issued and outstanding as of June 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Class A Voting Common Stock and the Class
B Non-Voting Common Stock are identical in all respects except that each holder of the Class A Voting Common Stock shall be entitled to
cast one vote for each outstanding share while Class B Common Stock do not have voting rights. No holder of shares of Class A Voting Common
Stock or Class B Non-Voting Common Stock shall be entitled to preemptive or subscription rights. All preferences, voting powers, relative,
participating, optional or other special rights and privileges, and qualifications, limitations, or restrictions of the Common Stock of
the Company are expressly made subject and subordinate to those that may be fixed with respect to any shares of the Preferred Stock of
the Company.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The holders of Series A Preferred Stock are entitled
to various protective provisions and preferences. Holders of Series A Preferred Stock are entitled to vote on an as-converted basis with
holders of Class A Common Stock and to appoint directors.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The holders of Series A Preferred Stock are entitled
to dividend preferences over holders of Common Stock and to preferred dividends at a rate of 10% per annum of the original issue price
($<span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--Dividends_pp0d_c20260101__20260630__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__us-gaap--SeriesAPreferredStockMember_zfX0MPX92Pte" title="Dividend"><span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--Dividends_pp0d_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__us-gaap--SeriesAPreferredStockMember_zrI7AghMmMT" title="Dividend">12,500,000</span></span> as of June 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025) plus all previously accrued dividends, compounded annually. As of June 30, 2026
and December 31, 2025, accrued dividends of $<span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--DividendsPayableCurrent_iI_pp0d_c20260630__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__us-gaap--SeriesAPreferredStockMember_zrIHfiRiEIo5" title="Accrued dividends">8,805,887</span> and $<span id="xdx_90B_eus-gaap--DividendsPayableCurrent_iI_pp0d_c20251231__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__us-gaap--SeriesAPreferredStockMember_ztiKQH7k4Sdj" title="Accrued dividends">7,791,322</span>, respectively, and were outstanding but undeclared. The dividend
rates are subject to dilution protections.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>



<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"></p>



<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"></p>





<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The holders of Series A Preferred Stock
are entitled to a liquidation preference over holders of Common Stock but subordinate to Senior Preferred Stock, at the original issuance
price ($3.3956) per share plus any accrued and unpaid dividends, providing a total liquidation preference of $<span id="xdx_902_eus-gaap--PreferredStockLiquidationPreference_iI_c20260630__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__us-gaap--SeriesAPreferredStockMember_z9wmVBSyCZJ2">21,305,887</span>
and $<span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--PreferredStockLiquidationPreference_iI_c20251231__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__us-gaap--SeriesAPreferredStockMember_zUO2iTD8SgOc">20,291,321</span>,
as of June 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025, respectively. The Series A Preferred Stock are convertible, at the holder&#8217;s election,
into Class A Common Stock at a dilution protected rate that is currently 1:1. The Series A Preferred Stock are mandatorily convertible
into Class A Common Stock if and upon a qualifying initial public offering, as defined in the articles of incorporation.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Series A Preferred Stocks are subject to optional
redemption at the holder&#8217;s election on or after December 2, 2024, at a price of the greater of the original issuance price ($3.3956
per share) plus any accrued and unpaid dividends or the fair value at the redemption date as agreed between the Company and the holders
or based upon a third-party appraisal. As a result of its redemption provisions, the Series A Preferred Stock was not classified as part
of stockholders&#8217; equity in the accompanying condensed consolidated balance sheets in accordance with ASC 480-10-S99, &#8220;SEC
Materials&#8221;, and instead is excluded from stockholders&#8217; equity and presented as temporary equity. The carrying balance is adjusted
annually for accretion to the redemption value to reflect the accruing dividends on the Series A Preferred Stock.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Senior Preferred Stock is non-voting and is not
convertible into common stock. Senior Preferred Stock is entitled to various rights, protections, and preferences, including a liquidation
preference of 2.5 times the original issuance price of $10.00 per share, equating to $<span id="xdx_90A_eus-gaap--PreferredStockLiquidationPreference_iI_c20260630__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--SeniorPreferredStockMember_zJ4ClnnmdcQc" title="Liquidation preference"><span id="xdx_906_eus-gaap--PreferredStockLiquidationPreference_iI_c20251231__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--SeniorPreferredStockMember_z2hvtHJ395ik" title="Liquidation preference">12,500,000</span></span> as of June 30, 2026 and December 31,
2025. During 2025, the Company issued <span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--SeniorPreferredStockMember__srt--CounterpartyNameAxis__custom--TZPGroupInvestmentsLPMember_pd" title="Shares issued">500,000</span> shares of Senior Preferred Stock to TZP Group Investments, LP, a related party, for gross
proceeds of $<span id="xdx_904_eus-gaap--ProceedsFromIssuanceOfConvertiblePreferredStock_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--SeniorPreferredStockMember__srt--CounterpartyNameAxis__custom--TZPGroupInvestmentsLPMember_pp0p" title="Proceeds from senior preferred stock">5,000,000</span>.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Senior Preferred Stock ranks senior to the
Series A Preferred Stock and to all classes of common stock with respect to distributions upon any liquidation, dissolution or winding
up of the Company and upon a deemed liquidation event. Holders of Senior Preferred Stock are entitled to dividends only when, as and if
declared by the Board of Directors. The Senior Preferred Stock does not accrue dividends, is not entitled to cumulative dividends, and
does not participate in dividends declared on the common stock. No dividends have been declared or paid on the Senior Preferred Stock
since issuance.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Because the Senior Preferred Stock is redeemable
upon the occurrence of a deemed liquidation event, which is not an event solely within the control of the Company, the Senior Preferred
Stock is presented outside of permanent stockholders' equity (deficit) as temporary equity in the accompanying condensed consolidated
balance sheet in accordance with ASC 480-10-S99. The Senior Preferred Stock is not mandatorily redeemable within the meaning of ASC 480-10-25-4,
because redemption is conditioned both upon the occurrence of a deemed liquidation event and upon the election of the requisite holders,
and neither condition represents an unconditional obligation or an event certain to occur. Accordingly, the Senior Preferred Stock is
not classified as a liability. The Senior Preferred Stock was initially recorded at its issuance-date fair value of $<span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--ProceedsFromIssuanceOfPreferredStockAndPreferenceStock_c20260101__20260630__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--SeniorPreferredStockMember_pp0p" title="Proceeds from the sale of senior preferred stock, net">4,859,967</span>, representing
gross proceeds net of issuance costs. Because the Senior Preferred Stock is not currently redeemable, and the Company has determined that
it is not probable that it will become redeemable, the Company has not adjusted the carrying amount of the Senior Preferred Stock to its
redemption amount. The Company reassesses this determination at each reporting date. <span id="xdx_90C_ecustom--RedemptionDescription_c20260101__20260630__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--SeniorPreferredStockMember_zRTtPYAmZky7" title="Redemption description">If redemption were to become probable, the Company
would accrete the carrying amount to the redemption amount of $12,500,000 (an increase of $7,640,033 as of June 30, 2026) over the period
from the date redemption becomes probable to the earliest redemption date, with the resulting charge recorded against retained earnings
or, in the absence of retained earnings, additional paid-in capital, and deducted from net loss in determining net loss attributable to
common stockholders.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">As of June 30, 2026, the aggregate amount payable
to the holders of Senior Preferred Stock and Series A Preferred Stock, in priority to the holders of Class A Voting Common Stock and Class
B Non-Voting Common Stock, upon a liquidation, dissolution or winding up of the Company or upon a deemed liquidation event was $<span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--PreferredStockLiquidationPreference_c20260630_pd" title="Liquidation preference">33,805,887</span>,
consisting of $<span id="xdx_906_eus-gaap--PreferredStockLiquidationPreference_c20260630__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--SeniorPreferredStockMember_pd" title="Liquidation preference">12,500,000</span> payable to holders of Senior Preferred Stock and $<span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--PreferredStockLiquidationPreference_c20260630__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__us-gaap--SeriesAPreferredStockMember_pd" title="Liquidation preference">21,305,887</span> payable to holders of Series A Preferred Stock.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">As of December 31, 2025, the aggregate amount
payable to the holders of Senior Preferred Stock and Series A Preferred Stock, in priority to the holders of Class A Voting Common Stock
and Class B Non-Voting Common Stock, upon a liquidation, dissolution or winding up of the Company or upon a deemed liquidation event was
$<span id="xdx_90A_eus-gaap--PreferredStockLiquidationPreference_c20251231_pd" title="Liquidation preference">32,791,321</span>, consisting of $<span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--PreferredStockLiquidationPreference_c20251231__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--SeniorPreferredStockMember_pd" title="Liquidation preference">12,500,000</span> payable to holders of Senior Preferred Stock and $<span id="xdx_90D_eus-gaap--PreferredStockLiquidationPreference_c20251231__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__us-gaap--SeriesAPreferredStockMember_pd" title="Liquidation preference">20,291,321 </span>payable to holders of Series A Preferred
Stock.</p>



<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"></p>



<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"></p>




<span></span>
</td>
</tr>
